guitar.notes: Daron Malakian is commonly seen with Gibson Les Pauls and Flying Vs; reasonably documented, medium confidence.

tone.target: tight low-tuned nu-metal crunch with dry mid-scooped bite
tone.profile: tight low-tuned nu-metal crunch with dry mid-scooped bite
tone.summary: A modern metal/nu-metal chain utilizing a Recti-style amp model, heavy distortion, boost for attack, and incorporating wah for lead passages.
corrections: Make wah part explicit, not optional
Keep mids scooped but not fizzy

rig.name: System of a Down - Toxicity - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and tighten the low-end rhythm chugs.
Increase the initial attack and punch for tight palm-muting.
Provide high-gain saturation and the necessary mid-scooping for nu-metal crunch.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is used to emulate a modern, aggressive metal tone (like Mesa/Recti) without specific EQ controls. Careful setting of Tone is crucial.

blocks.purpose: Implement the required occasional wah lead sound for solos/riffs.
Simulate the required Mesa/Rectifier-style high-gain power section.
Provide the necessary 4x12 cabinet voicing for modern metal aggression.
blocks.gap: While 'Mess 4x12' might be more aggressive, 'UK Vintage 4x12' is chosen as a reliable standard that can be EQ'd aggressively enough to fit the genre.

blocks.purpose: Fine-tune the tone by aggressively scooping the mids while maintaining low-end tightness and high-end bite.
Add minimal, non-washy ambience to prevent the sound from being too sterile.
blocks.gap: The requirement is 'dry rhythm attack' and 'avoid washy reverb'. Room is used at a very low mix level for subtle space without muddying the punch.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet simulation for maximum modern metal aggression and tightness.

proposals.reason: The current 'UK Vintage' is too generic; a dedicated modern metal IR will improve tightness and aggression.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased punch and definition in low-end chugs.
